title: Kanmani Anbudan
episodeTitle: Kanmani Sets Terms for Her Stay
description: Assuring her support, Mathangi leaves Kanmani at Anbu's home after explaining her conditions to his family. Later, Varathan makes Kanmani stay in Anbu's room despite her refusal.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Urged by Ragavan, Revathi leaves with Thangaraj, leaving Bagyaraj shattered. The promise of protection breaks instantly as Thangaraj's family mocks and warns Revathi.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Palanivel feels happy to be reunited with Pandian's family once again. Muthuvel firmly tells Sakthivel he will secure Palanivel and Gomathi's rightful share of the property.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila and Cheran invite Kasturi, Chidambaram, and Karthika for Cheran's engagement. Later, Aravind and Selvam confuse Vannathi about medical shop losses over the Bihar trip.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Nachiyar proposes Meena and Shruthi's remarriages to Muthu and Ravi. Their mothers agree, take them home and begin preparations for the weddings.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: The family rejoices as Azhagar and Meenatchi utter their first words. Sethupathi surprises Aishwarya with room decorations, a saree and jewellery as her wedding day gift.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
episodeTitle: Maran Sets Out to Find Kasthuri
description: After regaining consciousness, Maran reveals Kasthuri has eloped with her lover, shocking the family. Determined to bring her back, Maran and Jaganathan search with their goons.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Abhi urges Shanmugam to reveal their relationship to his family. Without Kandhasamy's knowledge, Murugan makes arrangements with Ganesan to launch his Biryani business.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: Bold Talent Battles for Selection
description: Feroz brings energy, while fiercely independent Kamatchi inspires. Venkatesan owns the stage, and Jason impresses with kickboxing as the judges search for their pick.
